evidence.reason: The current file still writes ST directly with Path.write_text at lines 49-51 (and similarly at 35-36). A crash or interruption during that truncate/write can leave invalid JSON, and line 30 loads ST without a guard, so every later timer run raises JSONDecodeError before the watchdog can alert. This is a concrete recoverability defect in the watchdog's existing state handling, not merely a new requirement; atomic replace plus explicit malformed-state recovery is the smallest compatible fix.
